description: This file defines the `PermissionRequester` class responsible for managing runtime permissions in an Android application. It handles requesting permissions, displaying rationales, and directing users to app settings when necessary, using coroutines, activity result APIs, and lifecycle-aware dialogs.

classes.name: PermissionRequester
classes.description: A class to request and manage runtime permissions, providing rationale dialogs and redirecting to app settings when needed.

methods.name: requestIfMissing
methods.description: Requests permissions if they are missing, handling rationales and merging results with current permission state.

methods.name: showRationaleDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog explaining the need for permissions, suspending until user responds.

methods.name: showSettingsDialog
methods.description: Shows a dialog prompting the user to enable permissions in app settings, suspending until dismissed.

methods.name: buildRationaleMessage
methods.description: Constructs a message explaining why permissions are needed.

methods.name: buildSettingsMessage
methods.description: Constructs a message guiding users to enable permissions in settings.

methods.name: permissionLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for a given permission string.
